title: Trove browser visit
description: One line of browser/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl: one page visit, from a browser-history import (source "history") or a live extension span (source "extension"). Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

time.description: RFC3339 local time the visit (or span) began

profile.description: browser profile name for history rows; empty for extension rows (the tabs API does not expose it)

duration_secs.description: time on the page: the browser's own figure for history rows, the engaged wall time (focused-active or audible) for extension rows; 0/absent when unknown

source.description: provenance; defaults to "history" when absent. Readers prefer extension rows where both cover the same browsing.

audible.description: extension rows: the tab played audio at some point in the span

foreground_secs.description: extension rows: seconds spent as the focused-active tab (≤ duration_secs)

favicon.description: extension rows: the tab's favicon URL

referrer.description: extension rows: the page this visit was navigated from, when the browser could tell

transition.description: extension rows: how the navigation happened per the browser (link, typed, reload, form_submit, …)

tab_count.description: extension rows: open tabs across all windows when the span opened
